name: grc-flood-emsr933
notes:
This dataset contains Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping products for activation EMSR933. On 01 October 2026, a severe rainfall and flooding event was reported to have affected Crete, Greece. The event is ongoing and increasing, with damage reported to affect buildings, critical infrastructure, transportation networks, agricultural areas and private properties. Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping is requested to provide flood extent and damage assessment emergency mapping.

**Citation:** Copernicus Emergency Management Service (© 2026 European Union), EMSR933

**Product types present in this dataset's resources:**  
**DEL (Delineation)**: maps the extent of the event itself (eg. flood, fire, landslide boundary).

Where a GeoPackage download is available for an Area of Interest/round, it already contains every layer with its official Copernicus styling and colours - prefer it in GIS software over the zipped shapefile download.
